decisions.reason: Because this schlager CD remains close to the core physical-music catalog and has already been defended once, management is inclined to persist with it, even if its longer market life raises the chance of eventual withdrawal somewhat.
This jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's curation-led reissue business and genre-broadening direction, so sunk preparation costs and public commitment make management reluctant to drop it.
A multi-disc box set is a highly visible, collector-oriented investment near the firm's core offer, which under escalation of commitment makes reversal especially unlikely.

Although this compilation CD appears less prominently committed than the others, it is still a close extension of the core catalog, so management would usually keep it unless its performance were clearly disappointing.
